notation: Logical Arabic in the engine notation (engines.sotn). Keep every command of the original, in order: {wait N} pauses the typewriter N frames, {speed N} makes it type a glyph every N frames, {flag N} starts one of the animations the text is timed with and {wait-flag N} waits for one to end. Line ends (\n) are the translation's own: a line holds at most 152 pixels (19 English letters), the box shows three lines and a fourth scrolls it. A message holds Arabic, spaces and punctuation (. ! : ، ؛ ؟) only. The speakers' names (name.*) are one line of text. No vowel marks: the font has none.

entries.context: Richter, facing Dracula on his throne; ST0 cutscene message 0
